prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop web app redesign composition comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity UI composition mockup for the Korean elementary literacy app “관점 렌즈 사건실” (Perspective Lens Case Room). Show a learner moving through a fictional case as a small editorial workspace: two voices, sentence evidence, a changed first thought, and a next action. It must read as an application, not a poster or concept art.
Structure/composition: “reading table” layout. The first viewport has a large left reading column with a clear case question and two narrator tabs; a narrow vertical timeline of sentence numbers and evidence marks runs through the center; a right-side “내 생각 기록” panel compares first and revised judgments with a small neutral-record reveal control. A compact six-step strip stays at the top, and a single “비교 완료” CTA anchors the lower right. On narrow screens the reading column, timeline, and thought panel stack in this order.
Use real Korean labels where readable: “관점 렌즈 사건실”, “사건 접수”, “렌즈 A/B”, “근거 보드”, “교차 조사”, “관점 전환”, “사건 보고서”, “관찰 사실”, “인물의 추론”, “평가 표현”, “내 생각 기록”, “비교 완료”.
Identity reference: use the attached existing screenshot only for its light paper surface, dark navy ink, restrained teal/orange accents, compact document borders, and legible Korean type. Do not copy exact layout or text from the reference.
Style/material: printed classroom worksheet with a single orange margin mark for active attention, teal underlines for selected evidence, hairline rules, paper-white background, no gradients, no dark mode, no glass, no emoji icons, no stock photography, no invented logos.
Interaction cues: one evidence row is selected with a visible label, current keyboard focus ring is shown, first/revised thoughts have explicit text labels, disabled steps explain what is missing. Touch targets are at least 44px.
Quality: polished production UI mockup, crisp typography, believable component spacing, first-viewport task clarity, subtle depth from paper layers only. Avoid generic SaaS dashboard, three equal feature cards, fake metrics, excessive rounded pills, tiny unreadable text, purple/blue AI gradients, watermarks.
